unchanged: Original >=69 linear TIR actual days0–364; same historical baseline/annual rules and calendars. All original results authoritative.

selection.target: All original randomized study eyes separately by trial: T660; AC312 eyes/270 people. Outcome eye-specific strict qualification. Equal-eye estimand, clusters resampled as participants.
selection.model: Logistic main effects; continuous age/10, baselineVA/10, duration/10, HbA1c; centered at bootstrap weighted median for numerical scaling. Fixed ridge1e-6 on slopes, unpenalized intercept, no variable selection/interactions/outcome-dependent tuning. Newton max100 iterations tol1e-9; convergence tested by score and step. Record any failure.
selection.missing: Numeric nonfinite: median imputation among unique original participants for person variables, eyes for baselineVA, recomputed per bootstrap, plus fixed missing indicators. Categorical missing/unknown retained explicitly. Fixed factor coding from original baseline roster before modeling; no missing outcome recovery. Missingness itself remains a selection limitation.
selection.weights: Stabilized q/p; q=strict selected sampled eyes/all sampled eyes. At point fit truncate selected weights to 1st/99th empirical linear percentiles; each bootstrap recomputes q,p,cutoffs and normalizes weights. Untruncated sensitivity reported alongside. Weighted mean normalized by actual selected weighted eye sum.
selection.diagnostics: Probability quantiles all and selected. Raw and truncated weights quantiles/min/max. ESS=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2). Balance versus all original eyes using fixed original-eye SD for continuous and sqrt(p(1-p)) for indicator columns. Assess all model terms including missingness; intercept omitted.
selection.qualification: QUALIFIED only if point fit converges; all original-eye p>=0.05; raw selected max/median<=10; truncated ESS>=0.50*selected eyes; weighted max abs SMD<=0.10; weighted mean abs SMD improves (tolerance1e-8); all5000 bootstrap fits/estimates finite. Otherwise NOT_QUALIFIED; report values as diagnostics only, no population recovery claim.
selection.CST: Not modeled: device-specific scales and ambiguous/missing assignments already identified; no optional model shopping.

common_support.evidence: Local prior MinerU protocol Markdown; verify exact criterion against original protocols. Fixed protocol intersection, not empirical min/max outcome-driven trimming.
common_support.direct_standardization: Conditional on >=20 eyes and >=20 participants per trial per frozen bin. Target weights=0.5*(T proportion + AC proportion) within common-range strict eyes. Bootstrap re-estimates within-bin summaries and pooled proportions; all endpoints/calendars shared same participants. Report each-trial standardized MAE and signed difference and AC-minus-T discrepancy. If insufficient do not merge bins; NOT_QUALIFIED.

bootstrap.structure: Historical phase1 Boot: T stratified original randomized arm; AC whole-trial participants. Selection analysis draws ORIGINAL roster; all original fellow eyes and qualifications included with multiplicity. Common support draws original strict populations then conditions on fixed masks. Independent trial streams; same replicate pairs calendars/within-trial endpoints.
bootstrap.CI: Percentile2.5/97.5 linear; do not redraw failed fits. Log all5000 replicate validity. Weighted-minus-unweighted change uses SAME sampled selected eyes and same bootstrap replicate.

examples.high: Retain v1 maximum observed >=69 conversion count, then max absD8, then numeric participantID/eye.
examples.central: For each trial minimize absolute distance of absD8 to trial median absD8; then distance of absD12 to trial median absD12; then ascending numeric participantID/eye. All from frozen strict eyes; illustrative not representative. No visible source ID.

stopping: Author review; no further study or submission
